"THE COUNTDOWN"
Warm up: Get Loose and hit some light KB Swings 3 sets of 10 reps.
1. Back Squat 5 reps @ 65%, 4 reps @ 75%, 3 reps @ 80%, 2 reps @ 87%, 1 rep @ 92%
rest 2:00
2. a. Bench Press 5 reps @ 65%, 4 reps @ 75%, 3 reps @ 80%, 2 reps @ 87%, 1 rep @ 92%
super set b. One Arm Dumbbell Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
rest 2:30 between each super set
3. Close Grip Bench Press N sets @ 33% of bench press max
* Get 100 reps with 33% of your Bench Max. Goal is to get the 100 reps in the fewest sets possible. Rest at your discretion
Recovery: Steak & mashed Potatoes · Big Sleep 8+ hrs · 30 min Walk
